entries.german: nachdem er den Peter von Rosenberg an seiner statt in Böhmen zurückgelassen hat. Sein schwager Heinrich von NiederBaiern war am 1. sept. gestorben. Da sich kaiser Ludwig schon der vormundschaft und des landes bemächtigt hatte, zieht er weiter. Vita 259.
entries.english: after he had left Peter von Rosenberg in his place in Bohemia. His brother-in-law Heinrich of Lower Bavaria had died on September 1. Since Emperor Ludwig had already taken hold of the guardianship and the land, he continues onward. Vita 259.
